settings.methodology: Fanout server-side accepted-row counter deltas divided by measured wall time; telemetrygen emits one parent and one child span per trace tick. Split runs bracket each phase with generator-host /proc/stat reads over the generator SSH setup, including startup and export draining. Generator CPU cores = logical CPUs × (total tick delta − idle and iowait tick delta) / total tick delta; guest ticks are not counted twice. Invalid trials take precedence; accepting at least 95% of the target remains target-sustained. Otherwise generator CPU at or above 90% is generator-limited; below 90%, a sweep gain under 10% over the preceding process count for the same signal and repetition is saturated. Without a valid previous sweep point or a plateau, the existing acceptance-ratio classification applies; same-host runs retain that fallback. The sustained phase uses the mixed sweep topology with highest accepted throughput meeting the read target, or the best read-completion fallback if none qualifies.

warnings: Results describe this exact host, Fanout build, configuration, dataset, and workload; they are not universal capacity claims.
telemetrygen payloads are intentionally synthetic and highly compressible; storage size is not representative of production telemetry.
Offered load is a target. Headline throughput uses Fanout's accepted-row counters, never telemetrygen's intended or generated count.
This suite measured writes only. Configure query load to claim mixed read/write performance.
